summary.text: Bruce Bickford is a Republican state senator who has represented Maine Senate District 20 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A pharmacy technician, he previously served in the Maine House and on the Auburn City Council.

paragraphs.text: Bickford earned a high school diploma from Edward Little High School.
His career experience includes working as a pharmacy technician and managing small businesses.
Bickford served on the Auburn City Council from 2006 to 2008, in the Maine House from District 70 from 2008 to 2012, and in the Maine House from District 63 from 2014 to 2022.
He assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 3, 2024, succeeding Eric Brakey, and for 2025 and 2026 was assigned to the Taxation Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
